purpose: Teach: 講和/反米/布告/監禁/仮処分/歪曲/流布/招集

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦後の講和条約の交渉過程を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper covered the negotiation process of the postwar peace treaties, didn't it?
lines.style: Warm, confirming tone. Measured pace. A teacher checking in on a student's work with genuine interest, not interrogation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、冷戦期の反米運動を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about the anti-American movements during the Cold War period.
lines.style: Steady, direct response. Slight hesitation at the start—checking he has the right answer. Even pace, no flourish. Respectful distance.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、開戦時の宣戦布告を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper dealt with the declaration of war at the outbreak, didn't it?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before the question. Slower cadence, as if drawing a connection. Gentle but searching—she's following a thread of his work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、戦時下の不当監禁を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on the issue of unlawful detention during wartime.
lines.style: Quiet correction without defensiveness. He's not arguing, just clarifying what he actually wrote. Slight upward lilt at the end, seeking acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 民事の仮処分制度を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your paper addressed the provisional attachment system in civil law, then?
lines.style: Engaged, forward-leaning tone. She's actively tracking his academic trajectory. Warm curiosity, no judgment. Direct eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、歴史教科書の歪曲問題を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined the historical textbook distortion problem.
lines.style: Patient repetition of the correction. He's not frustrated, just persistent in being clear. Even tempo. Quiet confidence that his actual research matters.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦時下の流言流布を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you handled wartime rumor circulation in your paper, correct?
lines.style: Slow, almost gentle reframing. She's not catching him out—she's reflecting on the breadth of his interests. Tone carries quiet respect.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、緊急時の議会招集を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about the emergency summoning of the Diet during crisis periods.
lines.style: Final answer, settled. Breath slightly tighter—he's tired of the pattern of questions. But he doesn't snap. Closing statement energy. Even, concluding.
